_doc: Neutral en-us writer placeholders for expEvent_sm_acceptance.json. Keys match zh-cn; legacy keys retained.

en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_acceptance_ongoing: On the final day the old man finishes the wooden gag with his own hands - built to her measurements.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_acceptance_result: The acceptance begins. $names$ is fitted with the perfectly-sized gag.
en-us.event_erav_sm_acceptance_01:
On the last day the old man completes the wooden gag by hand - sized from the measurements taken at her first-day inspection, fitting without a gap.
"Acceptance subject: present this week's lessons - to your supervisor."
(Note: the return report at the end of her stay belongs to the release event. For now, the master inspects the goods himself.)
en-us.event_erav_sm_acceptance_02: The demonstration over, he puts on his reading glasses, lays her on the mat at the very center of the playroom and performs the final inspection himself - the way a craftsman tries his own work before it leaves the shop.
en-us.event_erav_sm_acceptance_03:
He stamps her 'toy registration card' - the card signed the day she entered the house, printed with her specifications and usage record.
"Qualified. Feel, endurance, etiquette - all in order."
en-us.event_erav_sm_acceptance_04:
"There's a colleagues' gathering in a week. I'll borrow you again then. Have the Kiryu-gumi forward the rent. ...Go home."
In the car back she stares at the card the whole way. Specifications, depth, tolerance, sensitivity rankings - her body's data laid out in neat print, and on the last page a blank waiting to be filled:
"Next scheduled use: ______"
en-us.event_erav_sm_acceptance_err: [ERROR] Scene targets missing (no party, or the client could not be borrowed from the Kiryu-gumi).
